structured.answer: If my gemel is in one of the big houses' equity tracks, I'm about average: their 5-year averages sit around 12.1–12.7% a year and their fees are all about 0.5–0.6%, so I'm not losing real money. Only מיטב עוקב מדדי מניות (17.2%) and אינפיניטי מניות (15.8%) stand out, and I'd check them over a longer period before moving.
